messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a rolling deploy of runtime v3.5 to prod Wednesday 2026-03-18 22:00 UTC. Canary 1% for 15m, then 10% for 10m, then 100% if green. Need smoke owners and rollback readiness. Ping @maria @jamal @sophie

alex: TL;DR pre-deploy checklist:
- [ ] owners assigned for each smoke test
- [ ] canary window scheduled (22:00 UTC)
- [ ] feature-flag prepared: runtime_v3_5_swap
- [ ] rollback runbook validated
- [ ] alerting thresholds set (latency + error rate)
- [ ] DB migration = no

maria: I'm happy to own API smoke (latency + 5xx) — I'll run the following:
- curl -sS https://api.redwood-inference/prod/ping | jq .
- run load test: hey -z 1m -q 50 -c 10 https://api.redwood-inference/v1/generate
Will post results in this thread. :+1:

jamal: I'll own infra-level checks (GPU pool, KV cache sanity)
Quick checklist:
- check node health: kubectl get pods -n runtime -o wide
- GPU metrics: grafana -> infra/gpu_pools
- KV cache hitrate: query internal dashboard
Rollback plan:
1) flip feature flag runtime_v3_5_swap -> off
2) scale down new ASG and scale up old
3) revert kernel config if needed

sophie: Question: do we need config toggles for quantization profiles? runtime_v3_5 introduces q4_0 as default for small models.
If yes, can we gate it behind runtime_quant_profile=q4_0 ?

alex: Yes please gate quant profile. We'll add:
- runtime_quant_profile: q4_0 (default OFF for canary)
Command to flip flag:
```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/set -d '{"flag":"runtime_v3_5_swap","value":true}'
```

deploy-bot: pipeline queued — build #488 for runtime v3.5. CI tests: unit, integration, canary smoke. ETA 12m.

maria: CI green for unit+int. I'll start canary smoke run at 21:55 UTC (pre-canary sanity).
Results: latency p95 120ms, 5xx 0.1% (baseline 0.08%). Monitoring fwded to #observability.

jamal: infra checks done. GPU avg util on canary pool 65%. KV hit 88% — within expected. Ready for canary.

sophie: Confirm quant flag is OFF for canary. I'll keep an eye on generation quality if we flip later.

alex: All right — owners: @maria (api smoke), @jamal (infra), @sophie (quality). Rolling window 22:00 UTC. I'll trigger feature flag at 22:00 and start canary. If any owner posts "stop" within first 15m — we rollback immediately. Otherwise escalate per usual.

maria: ack. I'll post a smoke summary by +10m.

jamal: ack, ready to execute rollback. I've got ops role.

sophie: ack. will monitor quality dashboards.

deploy-bot: 22:00 UTC — feature flag flip executed by alex. Canary at 1% started.

maria: +10m smoke: p95 130ms, 5xx 0.3% -> marginally higher. I'm going to run targeted retry test and check logs. Leaving canary open for additional 10m. :eyes: 

alex: noted. keeping canary extended. jamal, sophie, anything critical?

jamal: not critical from infra side. I see a small blip in cache miss rate, investigating tail latencies.

sophie: quality delta: minor nudge in repetition for one prompt family. Not a showstopper but logging testcases for follow-up.

alex: decision: continue to 10% sweep after 25m if no regressions >0.5% 5xx or >200ms p95. Anyone say "stop" otherwise I'll proceed at 22:25.

maria: stop — 5xx creeped to 0.8% after retries. Rolling back now from my side if you want me to hold?

alex: Roger. Initiating rollback sequence.

alex: rollback steps executed: flipped runtime_v3_5_swap -> false, scaled ASG back. Notifying observability.

deploy-bot: rollback completed. Build #488 canary instances terminated. Old instances back in service.

maria: Post-rollback smoke: p95 back to 115ms, 5xx 0.07%. Good.

jamal: infra stable. will open a postmortem PR with logs and timeline.

sophie: will capture quality diffs and sample prompts for research.

alex: Thanks team. We'll re-run the canary once we triage issues. Filing follow-up tasks:
- PR: investigate cache miss blip (jamal)
- Ticket: QA prompt regressions (sophie)
- Action: tighten alert thresholds for canary (maria)
I'll put a new deploy attempt on the calendar after fixes.

alex: closing here. :pray:
